scope: Named mechanisms at pinned source revisions; Claude built-in loop behavior refreshed from official documentation. Not a claim about every plugin or every possible prompt.

rows.name: Voyager · Automatic curriculum
rows.selection_en: Model chooses a new exploration task from world state and task history.
rows.selection_zh: 模型依環境與歷史，選下一個探索任務。
rows.setup_en: An exploration direction and game environment.
rows.driver_en: The running learning loop; no cron required.
rows.driver_zh: 學習迴圈接續執行，不靠 cron。

rows.name: Claude Code · /loop (no prompt)
rows.selection_en: Selects work within built-in maintenance: unfinished work, current PR, then bug hunts or simplification.
rows.selection_zh: 按內建範圍自行找工作：未完成事項、目前 PR，再找 bug 或簡化。
rows.setup_en: Start /loop; no task prompt is required for its built-in mode.
rows.setup_zh: 啟動 /loop 即可使用內建模式，不必另寫任務 prompt。
rows.driver_en: Dynamic scheduled wakeups; the model chooses the interval.
rows.driver_zh: 動態排程喚醒；模型選下一次間隔。

rows.name: OpenClaw · Heartbeat
rows.selection_en: Model handles the configured monitor responsibility. The default prompt says not to infer old tasks from prior chats.
rows.selection_zh: 模型處理設定的監看責任；預設 prompt 要求不從舊對話推導任務。
rows.setup_en: Monitor scratch or a custom prompt; proactive checks are opt-in.
rows.setup_zh: 設定 monitor scratch 或自訂 prompt；主動檢查需啟用。

rows.name: Hermes · /loop / /goal
rows.selection_en: Repeats the supplied task or selects further steps toward the assigned goal.
rows.selection_zh: 重複提供的任務，或選擇完成既定目標的下一步。
rows.setup_en: /loop requires a prompt; /goal requires an objective.
rows.setup_zh: /loop 要提供 prompt；/goal 要指定目標。
rows.driver_en: Loop scheduling or post-turn goal continuation.
rows.driver_zh: Loop 排程或回合結束後的目標續跑。

rows.name: Codex · /goal
rows.selection_en: Continues work toward an active assigned goal.
rows.selection_zh: 繼續完成有效的交辦目標。

rows.name: OpenBot · Routines / message_bot
rows.selection_en: Executes saved routine work or a peer’s assignment.
rows.selection_zh: 執行已存的例行工作或其他 Bot 派來的任務。
rows.driver_en: Scheduled queue work and handoff delivery.

rows.name: Grok reconstruction · event / completion wakes
rows.selection_en: Resumes work when automation records or delegated results arrive.
rows.selection_zh: 收到自動化紀錄或委派成果後接續工作。
rows.setup_en: An automation request or existing delegated task.
rows.setup_zh: 自動化要求或既有委派任務。
rows.driver_zh: 雲端紀錄輪詢與完成事件。

core: Task selection is distinct from wakeup timing.
voyager_code: propose_next_task builds observations; auto mode calls propose_next_ai_task, which calls the model and parses next_task. Special startup/inventory rules remain in the implementation.
